original: yena śravaṇamanananididhyāsanaiḥ samādhānaṃ prāptaṃ,śuddham ātmajñānaṃ labdhaṃ, saḥ satvaguṇaḥ|2.7.2.7.61

original: yasya ahaṅkāraḥ naṣṭaḥ, yasmin nairāśyaṃ vilasati, yasmin kṛpālutvaṃ vidyate, saḥ satvaguṇaḥ|2.7.62

original: svakāryādapi pūrvaṃ yaḥ parakāryaṃ sādhayati, maraṇottaraṃ yasya kīrtiḥ avaśiṣyate, saḥ satvaguṇaḥ|2.7.65

original: kāyakleśaḥ soḍhavyaḥ, durjanaiḥ saha sakhyaṃ rakṣati, nindakeṣu upakāraṃ karoti, saḥ satvaguṇaḥ|2.7.69

original: manaḥ apadhāvati, paraṃ tad vivekena rodhayati, indriyāṇi damayati,saḥ satvaguṇaḥ|2.7.70
analyzed: manaḥ apadhāvati param tat vivekena rodhayati indriyāṇi damayati saḥ sattva guṇaḥ

original: yasmai prātaḥsnānaṃ rocate, purāṇaśravaṇaṃ rocate, yaḥ nānā mantraiḥ devatārcanaṃ karoti,saḥ satvaguṇaḥ|2.7.72

original: yasya bhaktiviṣaye atilobhaḥ, yaḥ granthasāmagrīṃ saṅgṛhṇāti, nānā dhātumūrtīḥ pūjayati,saḥ satvaguṇaḥ|2.7.81

analyzed: yaḥ para bhūṣaṇena bhūṣaṇam manyate para dūṣaṇena dūṣaṇam manyate para duḥkhena khidyate saḥ satva guṇaḥ

original: saḥ dakṣaḥ, dhūrtaḥ,yogyaḥ, tārkikaḥ, satyaḥ, sāhityikaḥ, niyataḥ, marmajñaḥ, kuśalaḥ, capalaḥ, nānācamatkārayuktaḥ bhavati|2.8.13
